stubs.service: Woob bank-scraping backend (the Python bridge Kresus spawns to log into banks: Crédit Mutuel, Boursorama, Swile, Fortuneo)
stubs.how: KRESUS_PYTHON_EXEC points at .ui-capture/woob-stub.js, which speaks the same CLI/JSON protocol as server/providers/woob/py/main.py. It reports woob version 3.7 and answers 'accounts'/'transactions' from .ui-capture/data/woob-stub-data.json (generated by seed.js: the real balances and the last 45 days of transactions per access), so 'Sync' succeeds offline without creating duplicates. The Fortuneo access answers INVALID_PASSWORD to show an access in error.

stubs.service: Outgoing email (sendmail) used for alerts and weekly/monthly reports
stubs.how: KRESUS_EMAIL_TRANSPORT=sendmail with KRESUS_EMAIL_SENDMAIL_BIN=.ui-capture/sendmail-stub.sh, which appends messages to .ui-capture/data/outbox.mbox instead of delivering them. This enables the email/alerts UI.
KRESUS_SALT set to a local placeholder value.

notes: Kresus (self-hosted personal finance manager) run from its production build: client built with vite into build/client, server compiled with tsc into build/server, started with `node bin/kresus.js` (NODE_ENV=production) on PORT, SQLite DB at .ui-capture/data/db.sqlite. Single-user instance, no auth (Kresus' default; no login screen). Env is in .ui-capture/env.sh. Data is loaded through Kresus' own JSON import endpoint (POST /api/all/) by .ui-capture/seed.js; .ui-capture/reseed.sh recreates the DB from scratch (start.sh also seeds automatically if the DB is missing). Seed data: persona Camille Martin in Lyon, ~15 months of history (Aug 2025 – Nov 2026) across 4 bank accesses / 8 accounts: Crédit Mutuel everyday checking, Livret Bleu savings, PEL, mortgage; Boursorama joint account with partner Julien + PEA; Swile meal vouchers; an old Fortuneo savings access whose password is invalid (shows the error state). ~950 transactions with French bank raw labels (CB/PRLV/VIR), salary, rent/mortgage, groceries, utilities, subscriptions, holidays in Lisbon, CPAM refunds, cheques, custom labels on some, ~2% uncategorized, one duplicate pair to review. 22 custom categories, 14 categorization rules, budgets for the last 6 months on a user-created 'Household' view and on the default account, 5 alerts/reports, 7 recurring transactions (which Kresus materialises as upcoming transactions for the current month). Kresus polls all accesses through the woob stub at startup. Main areas: account sidebar grouped by bank, transactions list per account/view (search, categorize, edit), Charts/reports, Budgets, Duplicates, Categories, Recurring transactions, Settings (bank accesses, rules, emails & alerts, backup/import-export, customization). UI locale is English, currency EUR. Build reproduction (tools pinned in ../mise.toml: node 24.15.0, yarn 1.22.22 via npm backend): `yarn install --frozen-lockfile --no-default-rc` (--no-default-rc because yarn 1 walks parent dirs for .npmrc and the sandbox forbids reading ~/.npmrc; set npm_config_devdir=.ui-capture/cache/node-gyp; extsprintf tarballs contain a .gitmodules file the sandbox refuses to write, so fix-yarn-cache-gitmodules.py pre-populates yarn's cache for extsprintf 1.3.0/1.4.1 without it), then `NODE_ENV=production node_modules/.bin/vite build --mode production` and `NODE_ENV=production yarn build:server` (or node_modules/.bin/tsc --build --force after copying shared/ files, as scripts/build/server.sh does). No source files of the app were modified.
